lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like array of high-luminance circular clusters is visible on the lateral flank, posterior to the gill region. The visible constellation consists of approximately five horizontal rows and seven vertical columns of equidistant nodes of varying intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal linear ridges to form a lattice, with the high-luminance circular blobs situated at the geometric centers of these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible running longitudinally across the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity pixels on the upper edge to lower-intensity shadow pixels on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 8-10 low-contrast, high-luminance blobs of smaller diameter relative to the flank blobs, primarily located in the anterior-basal region of the fin mask.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior edge of the left pectoral fin exhibits a significant jagged indentation/amputation, consistent with mechanical trauma. Minor irregular notches are also visible on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Three elongated, low-luminance objects (remoras) are visible: two attached near the ventral-pectoral junction and one trailing the damaged posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
